suspect_items.problem: The model asserts the criterion predicate is present in the record while gold says not met. Either the generated record does state it (item is mislabelled), or it is underspecified and the item is unanswerable. Both are generator bugs being scored as reasoning failures.
suspect_items.action: Dump the full record for this item and adjudicate before attributing the error to the model.

polarity_structure.problem: All 13 matching criteria are encoded polarity=inclusion. There is no exclusion criterion anywhere in the task, so criterion-level polarity cannot be tested. polarity_structure.action: Either add exclusion-polarity items (the ClinicalTrials.gov pool has real exclusion criteria) or state plainly in Sec. 3.1 and the limitations that no released component exercises exclusion polarity in v0.1.
